text.p: Brookdale Living Communities Inc said Friday it has completed the purchase of two facilities for $46 million plus the assumption of bond financing.

One of the facilities, Edina Park Plaza, is a 201-unit senior and assisted living facility in an 18-story building in Edina, Minnesota. The deal involved assumption of about $13.3 million in tax-exempt bond financing. The property was sold by Edina Park Plaza Associates.
The other facility, Hawthorn Lakes, contains 202 units. Brookdale assumed about $12.5 million in tax-exempt bond financing as part of the purchase.

Brookdale also said it completed a sale-leaseback deal with Health and Retirement Properties Trust. In a release dated May 7, the company said it purchased Park Place, a 200-unit senior living facility in Spokane, Washington,and signed a 23-year lease with Health and Retirement Properties.
Brookdale provides senior and assisted living services to the elderly, operating facilities with a total of about 2,200 units.
